# Report Template

Shared module for generating consistent test generation reports across all four test layers.

## Usage

The caller must provide a summary object with the fields described below. The report is output as structured Markdown in the conversation.

## Report Structure

```markdown
## <Layer> Test Generation Report

**Generated by:** khufu-<layer> v<version> on <date>
**Mode:** <spec-based | code-based>
**Language:** <language> | **Framework:** <framework> | **Coverage Tool:** <coverageTool>

---

### Summary

| Metric | Count |
|--------|-------|
| Test files created | <N> |
| Test methods/scenarios | <N> |
| Happy path tests | <N> |
| Edge case tests | <N> |
| Error path tests | <N> |
| Fragile tests | <N> (only for UT) |
| Skipped (covered by lower layer) | <N> |
| Skipped (untestable — see report) | <N> (only for UT) |

---

### Compilation Verification

| Phase | Status | Details |
|-------|--------|---------|
| Source compilation (pre-generation) | ✅ Passed / ❌ Failed | <build command and result> |
| Test compilation (post-generation) | ✅ Passed / ⚠ Passed with auto-fixes / ❌ Failed | <auto-fixes applied or failure reason> |

**Auto-fixes applied:** (if any)
- <list of fixes: imports added, dependencies added, directories corrected>

**Compilation issues requiring manual intervention:** (if any)
- <error> → **Suggested fix:** <actionable suggestion>

---

### Test Execution Verification

| Category | Count | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| ✅ Passed | <N> | Tests ran and assertions passed |
| ❌ Failed (assertion) | <N> | Tests ran but assertions failed — target code may have bugs, or test expectations need review |
| 💥 Runtime Error | <N> | Tests could not execute — configuration or environment issue |
| ⏭️ Skipped | <N> | Not run (depends on failed prerequisite) |

**Dry-run smoke test:** ✅ Passed / ❌ Failed — <command and result>

**Runtime errors requiring attention:** (if any)
- <error message>
  - **Likely cause:** <diagnosis>
  - **Suggested fix:** <actionable steps>

**Assertion failures (for review):**
| Test | Failure Message | Possible Cause |
|------|----------------|----------------|
| <test name> | <message> | <bug in target code or wrong expectation> |

---

### Coverage Configuration

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Coverage tool | <tool> |
| Run command | `<command>` |
| Line threshold | <threshold>% |
| Branch threshold | <threshold>% |
| Exclusions | <list> |

---

### Spec Coverage  <!-- if spec system enabled -->

| Status | Count |
|--------|-------|
| Planned | <N> |
| Implemented | <N> |
| Evaluated & Passed | <N> |
| Evaluated & Failed | <N> |
| Deprecated | <N> |

**Orphan Tests:** <N> (tests without spec entries — consider adding specs)

---

### Evaluation Results  <!-- if EDD enabled -->

| Criteria | Target | Actual | Status |
|----------|--------|--------|--------|
| <dimension> | <target> | <actual> | ✅/❌ |

**Open Issues:**
- [ ] <issue requiring action>

---

### Files Created

| File | Test Count | Spec IDs |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| `<path/to/Test.ext>` | <N> | <list of spec IDs> |

---

### Layer-Specific Sections

**For UT (Unit Tests):**
- **Testability Assessment:**
  | File | Grade | Action |
  |------|-------|--------|
  | `ServiceA.java` | A | Standard tests generated |
  | `ServiceB.java` | B | PowerMock tests (fragile) |
  | `LegacyService.java` | C | Skipped — see `untestable-report.md` |
- **Fragile Tests:** <N> (excluded from CI by default)

**For IT (Integration Tests):**
- **Database Strategy:** H2 / Testcontainers (PostgreSQL) / Other
- **External Dependencies:** list of configured services

**For API (API Tests):**
- **Endpoint Coverage Matrix:**
  | Method | Path | Status Codes Covered | Schema Validated |
  |--------|------|--------------------|--------------------|
  | GET | /api/users | 200, 404 | ✅ |
  | POST | /api/users | 201, 400, 422 | ✅ |

**For E2E (E2E Tests):**
- **Scenario Coverage Matrix:**
  | Priority | User Journey | Test File | Status |
  |----------|-------------|-----------|--------|
  | P0 | Login flow | `login.spec.ts` | ✅ |
  | P1 | Password reset | — | ❌ Not covered |

---

### Next Steps

1. **Fix compilation issues** (if any): Review the Compilation Verification section above and apply suggested fixes.
2. **Fix runtime errors** (if any): Review the Test Execution Verification section and apply suggested fixes.
3. **Review assertion failures**: Determine if they indicate bugs in the target code or incorrect test expectations. Fix accordingly.
4. Run tests: `<command>`
5. Run with coverage: `<coverageCommand>`
6. Fix failing tests (iterate with the appropriate khufu skill)
7. Review spec at: `specs/<feature>/spec.v<N>.md` (if spec system enabled)
8. Address uncovered endpoints / scenarios listed in the coverage matrix
```

## Layer-Specific Note

Each skill (UT/IT/API/E2E) should include the relevant sections and omit inapplicable ones. The "Layer-Specific Sections" block above shows which sections apply to which layer.
